name: Mayotte
prevalence_note: La Poste in Mayotte has reported attempted scams through local media, and national French guidance documents fake parcel, contest and code requests.
cross_border_note: Mayotte shares +262 with Réunion, and receives calls from the Comoros (+269) and mainland France (+33).

scams.name: Faux concours ou colis La Poste
scams.name_en: Fake La Poste contest or parcel message asking for a code in Mayotte
scams.signals_en: A message claims a La Poste contest win or parcel fee and asks for card data or a code received by text.
scams.legit_en: French national cyber-assistance guidance advises ignoring such links and never passing on a code received by SMS.
bait_tactics: Demander quel bureau de Mamoudzou organise le concours
Dire que la carte bancaire est chez un proche à Petite-Terre
